canonical_project: Zhangzhou Big Data Center at Yutang Digital Economy Industrial Park
owner: Zhangzhou municipal authorities / Yutang Digital Economy Industrial Park
notes: Dongnan Net reported the launch ceremony for Zhangzhou Big Data Center phase 1A in Yutang Digital Economy Industrial Park. The city key project has planned investment of RMB 1 billion, about 40,000 sq m of floor area, three data-room buildings plus power support building, and capacity for about 5,000 cabinets.
